capabilities: Read notes aloud sentence by sentence
Start continuous playback from a clicked sentence in reading view
Cache synthesized audio per sentence in IndexedDB
Pregenerate audio through a persistent background queue
Connect several TTS providers plus the system voice
extras: Install by copying main.js, manifest.json and styles.css from Releases into .obsidian/plugins/voice-aloud/, or add the repository to BRAT. The built-in system voice works as an offline fallback without a provider account.
problem: Obsidian cannot read notes aloud on its own, and re-synthesizing audio for unchanged text wastes time and provider quota.

relations.evidence: Azure TTS (SSML with mixed-language <lang> spans for multilingual and HD voices

summary: Text-to-speech reader that plays notes sentence by sentence from a clicked sentence, with prefetched, hash-cached audio from several providers.
